يذلعب (form IVq)
# يَذْلَعِبُّ (yaḏlaʕibbu) /jað.la.ʕib.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# يُذْلَعَبُّ (yuḏlaʕabbu) /juð.la.ʕab.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# يَذْلَعِبَّ (yaḏlaʕibba) /jað.la.ʕib.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِذْلَع
